name: Kraken, Cloud
body:
Cloud Kraken CR 11

XP 12,800
N Huge magical beast
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +30

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 15, flat-footed 23 (+5 Dex, +13 natural)
hp 145 (10d10+90)
Fort +14, Ref +12, Will +7
Defensive Abilities Resist electricity 10, fire 10, cold 15

OFFENSE

Speed fly 70 ft. (good)
Melee 4 tentacles +22 (3d6+7/19-20)

STATISTICS

Str 25; Dex 21; Con 24; Int 2; Wis 19; Cha 16
Base Atk +15; CMB +18; CMD 33 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (tentacles), Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +30, Intimidate +24, Perception +20, Stealth +28
SQ flight

ECOLOGY

Environment any outside
Organization solitary or miasma (2-4)
Treasure none

The cloud kraken is a animalistic mass of tentacles that disappear within a cloud-sized fleshy mass. While the cloud kraken is moderately intelligent for an animal, it speaks no languages and does not communicate via language.

Typically, the diet of the cloud kraken is made up of prey like cattle, goats, larger humanoids, and other slower moving land-based creatures.

Cloud kraken actually have a physical mass, are corporeal, and are dirigible-like, where they are filled with some strange gaseous substance that keeps the airborne predator aloft and gives them excellent flying abilities. A larger group of these creatures, known as a miasma, only occurs during mating season. Cloud kraken do not care for their young, whom are born fully capable of flight (and have ravenous appetites).

A cloud kraken is typically shaped as a spheroid at least 50 feet across, and weighs approximately 400 to 800 pounds.

A cloud kraken can live for 100 years, and reaches maturity at 30 years of age.
